bucketNameOrArn.title: Bucket Name
bucketNameOrArn.description: The S3 Bucket name or Amazon Resource Name (ARN).

accessKey.title: Access Key
accessKey.description: The access key obtained from AWS.

secretKey.title: Secret Key
secretKey.description: The secret key obtained from AWS.

autoCreateBucket.title: Autocreate Bucket
autoCreateBucket.description: Setting the autocreation of the S3 bucket bucketName.

restartingPolicy.title: Restarting Policy
restartingPolicy.description: The restarting policy to use in streaming upload mode. There are 2 enums and the value can be one of `override`, `lastPart`.

batchMessageNumber.title: Batch Message Number
batchMessageNumber.description: The number of messages composing a batch in streaming upload mode.

batchSize.title: Batch Size
batchSize.description: The batch size (in bytes) in streaming upload mode.

streamingUploadTimeout.title: Streaming Upload Timeout
streamingUploadTimeout.description: While streaming upload mode is true, this option set the timeout to complete upload.

namingStrategy.title: Naming Strategy
namingStrategy.description: The naming strategy to use in streaming upload mode. There are 2 enums and the value can be one of progressive, random.

keyName.title: Key Name
keyName.description: Setting the key name for an element in the bucket through endpoint parameter. In Streaming Upload, with the default configuration, this is the base for the progressive creation of files.

useDefaultCredentialsProvider.title: Default Credentials Provider
useDefaultCredentialsProvider.description: Set whether the S3 client should expect to load credentials through a default credentials provider or to expect static credentials to be passed in.

useProfileCredentialsProvider.title: Profile Credentials Provider
useProfileCredentialsProvider.description: Set whether the S3 client should expect to load credentials through a profile credentials provider.

useSessionCredentials.title: Session Credentials
useSessionCredentials.description: Set whether the S3 client should expect to use Session Credentials. This is useful in situation in which the user needs to assume a IAM role for doing operations in S3.

profileCredentialsName.title: Profile Credentials Name
profileCredentialsName.description: If using a profile credentials provider this parameter sets the profile name.

sessionToken.title: Session Token
sessionToken.description: Amazon AWS Session Token used when the user needs to assume a IAM role.

uriEndpointOverride.title: Overwrite Endpoint URI
uriEndpointOverride.description: The overriding endpoint URI. To use this option, you must also select the `overrideEndpoint` option.

overrideEndpoint.title: Endpoint Overwrite
overrideEndpoint.description: Select this option to override the endpoint URI. To use this option, you must also provide a URI for the `uriEndpointOverride` option.

forcePathStyle.title: Force Path Style
forcePathStyle.description: Forces path style when accessing AWS S3 buckets.
